prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 25 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1272; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection and was diagnosed with concussion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the crash, and the clinical picture aligns with that history. Over the course of 25 visits, care followed a typical progression, with the frequency of appointments tapering as symptoms gradually improved and functional capacity returned. Examination findings were mixed: several objective measures support the diagnosis, while other assessments returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the same body region is documented in the available records. Billing records reflect a single charge for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated entries. Based on the current assessment, the patient is expected to continue improving with ongoing self-management and periodic follow-up as needed.
